phases.name: Phase 2 - Split: lower / upper / full
phases.progressionSummary: Move from one full-body session repeated three times a week to a lower / upper / full split, still three times a week.

modelNotes: Same Program -> Phase -> Day shape as nutrition, but 'day' here means SESSION ORDINAL within the week (1..sessionsPerWeek), not a calendar day.
Four calendar days a week have no session. The app renders those as an explicit rest day.
Phase 1 has 3 session templates that cycle across its 4 weeks - it is not 12 hand-written days.
ALL EXERCISE CONTENT IS PLACEHOLDER. Real programming comes from the Ultimate Fitness trainers.
Phase 1 sessionsPerWeek (3) and Phase 2 durationWeeks (4) were assumed - confirm with the gym.
